item.text: The hook already has a legacy encoder that applies punycode to every slash-separated URL segment. I’m replacing that with hostname-only conversion, using the existing `punycode.js` dependency, and adding the requested text-based hostname helper. The hook will notify and stop safely when a link has no extractable hostname.
